# VRML97 witness

Original hand-authored CC0 fixture. A concave five-corner polygon has area 3 m², is triangulated into three triangles, and is shared by two Shape instances through DEF/USE. The first Transform rotates 90 degrees about its centre (1,0,0), then translates (2,0,0). The material has RGB (0.25,0.5,1) and opacity 0.75; solid FALSE enables both sides.
